issues: 白底看板在黑场里被三段线性罩压成灰，紫光与白面板对比发脏
小字任务卡（22–30px 在超宽面板里）占满画面，没有主体，横摇不知道摇向哪里
匀速横摇在最后一帧戛然停住，没有终点也没有 hold
原片转角的彩虹色散没做，转角那一下没有记忆点
changes: look 换成 midnight：面板改成暗色路线图「Lodestar · Roadmap 2027」，120px 标题、四季度网格、三条甘特进度条与 TODAY 竖线；暗色 UI 只有被光照到才读得出
光的身份换成冰蓝白：四层辉光贴顶边走，光头下方一团青蓝光从顶边渗进界面，顶边发丝线本身被点亮一段
横摇有终点：Q4 发光发布卡「Lodestar 3 · Nov 12」是目的地；光头与面板共用一条 linear 时间轴，末 16f 同速刹停（速度连续降到 0），卡片描边亮起进 22f hold
补上转角色散：光头过左上角 ±2.4f 做红 / 蓝错位副本的 RGB 色散
开场就有戏：面板左缘在画内 420px，第 1 帧左缘竖直光线已在爬升
issuesEn: The white kanban was crushed to grey in the black void by a three-step linear mask, so the violet light against the white panel looked dirty
Small task cards (22-30px on a very wide panel) filled the frame with no subject, so the pan had nowhere to go
The uniform pan just stopped dead on the last frame, with no destination and no hold
The rainbow dispersion at the corner turn from the source film was missing, so the turn left no impression
changesEn: Midnight look: the panel is now a dark roadmap, 'Lodestar · Roadmap 2027', with a 120px title, a four-quarter grid, three Gantt bars and a TODAY line; the dark UI only reads where the light falls
The light becomes icy blue-white: a four-layer glow rides the top edge, a cyan-blue wash seeps in from the edge under the head, and the panel's top hairline itself lights up

The pan has a destination: a glowing Q4 launch card, 'Lodestar 3 · Nov 12'. Head and panel share one linear timeline, braking over the last 16f with continuous velocity down to zero, then the card's outline lights for a 22f hold
Corner dispersion added: as the head rounds the top-left corner, offset red and blue copies give a +/-2.4f RGB split
Something happens from frame 1: the panel's left edge starts 420px into frame with the vertical streak already climbing
